entities.summary: The Saint Charles Borromeo Cathedral is a Catholic temple located in the Don José Marcondes Homem de Melo Square, in the Brazilian city of São Carlos, São Paulo. It has a dome of more than 70 m (230 ft) in height and 30 m (98 ft) in diameter, which is an architectural replica of that of the Basilica of St. Peter in Vatican City.
